Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Libya has Law No. 6/2022 on Electronic Transactions (providing data protection provisions, e-commerce, digital signatures) and Law No. 5/2022 on Combating Cybercrime. These provide a legal basis for electronic transactions and digital government operations. The National Authority for Information Security and Safety (NISSA) oversees authentication. No specific cross-government data sharing act exists, but these laws provide a partial framework.
